title: The Locked Library
subtitle: A wizard's escape room
intro:
You come to on the cold flagstones of a forgotten wizard's library. Torches burn in iron sconces without a wisp of smoke, and a thin blade of moonlight falls through a high arched window. Shelves of crumbling tomes line the walls. The only way out is an ancient oak door sealed by a lock of four glowing runic dials.

The archmage who trapped you left clues behind. Search the room, gather what you find, and break the seal.
room_description: A dim wizard's library of stone and old oak. You see a writing desk, a towering bookshelf, a gilded painting, an enchanted grandfather clock, a faded crimson rug, torches in iron sconces, a high arched window, and a rune-sealed oak door.

desk.name: writing desk
desk.description: A scarred oak writing desk, crusted with old candle wax. A torn scrap of parchment lies beside a guttering candle. Beneath the top is a single drawer, held shut by three small brass dials.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.description: A towering shelf of spellbooks and crumbling tomes. Three volumes are bound in brighter leather, each spine marked with a single gilded numeral. From left to right: an emerald-green book marked 2, a crimson book marked 5 and a sapphire-blue book marked 8.

painting.name: painting
painting.description: A gilded painting of three robed scholars at study. From left to right they hold a crimson book, a sapphire-blue book and an emerald-green book. Nothing is hidden behind the frame.

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.description_locked: The drawer is held shut by three brass dials, each engraved with the numerals 0 to 9.
drawer.on_unlock: The dials click into place and the drawer slides open with a sigh of old wood. Inside, wrapped in velvet, lies a small moonstone lantern.

clock.name: grandfather clock
clock.description: An enchanted grandfather clock whose pendulum hangs frozen mid-swing. Its hands are stopped at 9:15. A brass plate beneath the face reads: 'When light fails, time holds the end.'

rug.name: rug
rug.description: A faded crimson rug woven with golden knotwork. You lift a corner: only cold flagstones and a startled spider beneath.

sconces.name: torch sconces
sconces.description: Iron sconces hold torches that burn with a steady, smokeless flame. Wizard's fire. The sconces are bolted firmly to the stone.

window.name: arched window
window.description: A narrow arched window set high in the wall, far too small to climb through. A crescent moon hangs outside, and its pale light falls across the floor.

door.name: rune door
door.description_locked: A massive oak door bound with iron bands. At its heart glows a lock of four runic dials, each able to show a numeral. The wards hum faintly. It will not yield to force.
door.description_open: The rune door stands open. Cool night air and freedom lie beyond.
door.on_unlock: The four runes blaze with blue fire and the wards shatter like glass. With a groan of ancient hinges the oak door swings open. You step out beneath the stars — you are free!

torn_note.name: torn parchment
torn_note.description: A torn scrap of parchment. In faded ink, in the archmage's spidery hand: 'Order matters. Ask the painting.'

moon_lantern.name: moonstone lantern
moon_lantern.description: A small brass lantern with a moonstone at its heart. Its pale violet light reveals what ordinary eyes cannot see.

interactions.text: Under the lantern's violet glow, silver letters bloom across the desk: 'The seal begins with 47.'
interactions.repeat_text: The silver letters still shimmer on the desk: 'The seal begins with 47.'

interactions.text: You sweep the violet light across the painting. The scholars stare back. Nothing glows.
The gilded spines shimmer, but reveal nothing new in the moonstone light.
The runes drink in the violet light and pulse, but the seal holds.
You hold the parchment up to the painting. The colours of the scholars' books seem to matter.

hints.text: Some of the tomes on the shelf are bound in brighter leather than the rest.
The parchment says to ask the painting. What are the scholars holding?
Read the numerals on the books in the order of the colours in the painting.
Something wrapped in velvet waits inside the open drawer.
Moonstone light reveals invisible ink. Try it on the furniture.
The clock has stopped. What time does it show?
You now know how the seal's code begins and how it ends.
